components.name: Logo
components.summary: The stateXchange lockup — angular two-piece S mark plus the wordmark with the enlarged X — rendered from tokens so it switches with the theme.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: The stateXchange line-icon set — 52 icons on a 24px grid, 2px stroke, round caps, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The single action control — four variants, three sizes, always one primary per view.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Inline navigation inside text, in `accent-text` with a 1px underline that thickens on hover.

components.name: Field
components.summary: A labelled text input or textarea with optional help or error text — the base of every form.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A native `<select>` styled to match Field, with a token-coloured chevron.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Native checkbox or radio with its label, tinted with `accent` via `accent-color`.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on/off toggle that takes effect immediately — a checkbox with `role="switch"`.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A compact status or category pill.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: An inline message about system state — info, success, warning or danger — with title, one-line explanation and icon.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short, non-blocking message confirming an action or reporting a background event, stacked bottom-right.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a table, list or dashboard shows when it has nothing to show — icon, one-line title, one-sentence explanation and at most one action.

components.name: Card
components.summary: The default container for a grouped piece of content, with optional eyebrow, title, body and footer.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: A KPI tile: uppercase label, large mono value with unit, and an optional delta + context line.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: Token-coloured SVG charts — line, area and bar — plus inline sparklines, with mono axis labels, hairline gridlines and no chart library.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: A horizontally scrollable data table with uppercase headers, right-aligned mono numbers and row hover.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page navigation for long tables and logs: a "Showing 126–150 of 312" summary on the left, previous/next plus numbered pages on the right.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between sibling views of one object (a deployment's Overview / Orders / Logs) without leaving the page.

components.name: Navbar
components.summary: The top bar: logo left, primary links centre, at most two actions right, `nav-height` tall with a hairline bottom border — with a built-in mobile drawer.

components.name: MobileMenu
components.summary: The small-screen navigation: a menu button in the Navbar (shown below 720px, or always with `sx-nav--compact`) opens a right-side drawer with large tap-target links and full-width actions.

components.name: Hero
components.summary: The landing-page opener: eyebrow, one headline, a lede, up to two CTAs and a mono proof-point row.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.summary: The eyebrow + heading + lede block that opens each page section.

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.summary: A numbered grid of capabilities — mono index, title, one-sentence body — in auto-fit columns.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: The site footer: logo + one-line positioning, 2–3 link columns, the Disclaimer, and the legal line with the registered entity name.

components.name: Disclaimer
components.summary: The standard regulatory notice, set small in `ink-3` above a hairline — required on every public page and in every client-facing export.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal confirmation for consequential actions — title as a question, body stating exactly what will and will not happen, actions right-aligned.

lastChange.note: Rebuilt manifest.json: component catalogue and asset groups registered.
